follow_up_questions.title: Rest pain or worsening pattern
follow_up_questions.question: Has the pressure ever come on at rest or woken you up, or is it coming more often, lasting longer or with less walking than before?
follow_up_questions.why: Rest or crescendo pain defines unstable angina and would call for same-day evaluation rather than outpatient referral.

follow_up_questions.title: Symptoms during exertional episodes
follow_up_questions.question: When the pressure comes on while walking, do you also get short of breath, sweaty, nauseated, lightheaded or feel like passing out?
follow_up_questions.why: Associated symptoms were only asked about for the present moment, not during episodes.

follow_up_questions.title: Allergies before aspirin and HCTZ
follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any allergies, especially to sulfa drugs or aspirin, and any history of stomach ulcers or bleeding?
follow_up_questions.why: Sulfa cross-reaction was mentioned and aspirin was started, but allergies and bleeding risk were not checked.

follow_up_questions.title: Smoking and cholesterol history
follow_up_questions.question: Do you smoke or have you ever smoked, and when was your cholesterol last checked?
follow_up_questions.why: These cardiac risk factors shape the work-up and the need for a statin.
